name: Cave.exe
source:
You find a weird cave. In this cave you will encounter strange creatures, absurd scenarios and unusual places. Your decisions determine the ending.

[From [url=https://wild-jerboa.itch.io/cave-exe]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你发现了一处古怪的洞穴。在里面，你会遇到奇异的生物、荒诞的状况和不同寻常的地方。结局由你的决定而定。
